# MAME files

From MAME (https://github.com/mamedev/mame), BSD-3-Clause, unchanged but for one line (i960.h's
`private:` made `protected:`, for the recompiler in src/rec):

- `i960/i960.cpp`, `i960/i960.h`: the Intel 80960 core (copyright-holders: Farfetch'd, R. Belmont)
- `i960/i960dis.cpp`, `i960/i960dis.h`: its disassembler (same holders)
- `m68000/m68000-sdf.cpp`, `m68000-sdp.cpp`, `m68000-head.h`, `m68000-decode.cpp`: the 68000's
  instruction handlers and decode table, generated by MAME's m68000gen.py (Olivier Galibert)

They compile against `src/core/shim_include/emu.h`, a stand-in for MAME's device framework.
`m68000/m68000.h` and `m68000/m68000.cpp` are MAME's 68000 device (Olivier Galibert) reduced to
the core: the address maps, MMU, save states and debugger replaced by a bus interface the board
implements (MAME's "interruptible" accesses with their wait states and retries).

Code ported from MAME lives in `src/`. Each file starts with the licence and copyright-holders
lines of the MAME files it comes from:

- `src/core/mb86233.*`: the Fujitsu MB86233/MB86234 (TGP) core, `cpu/mb86233/mb86233.cpp`
  (Olivier Galibert)
- `src/machine/model2a.*`: the Model 2A-CRX memory map, IRQ, timers, coprocessor glue and 2D video,
  `sega/model2.cpp` and `sega/model2_v.cpp` (R. Belmont, Olivier Galibert, ElSemi, Angelo Salese,
  Matthew Daniels); the 315-5649 I/O chip, `sega/315_5649.cpp` (Dirk Best); the 93C46 EEPROM,
  `machine/eepromser.cpp` (Aaron Giles); the i8251 transmitter, `machine/i8251.cpp` (smf, Robbbert);
  the scheduling of `emu/schedule.cpp` and `emu/diexec.cpp` (Aaron Giles); the FIFOs between the
  i960 and the TGP, `machine/gen_fifo.cpp` (Olivier Galibert)
- `src/machine/model2_video.*`: the geometrizer, rasterizer and polygon renderer, `sega/model2_v.cpp`,
  `sega/model2rd.ipp` and `sega/model2.h` (R. Belmont, Olivier Galibert, ElSemi, Angelo Salese,
  Matthew Daniels)
- `src/machine/poly.h`: the polygon scan converter, `video/poly.h` (Ville Linde, Aaron Giles)
- `src/machine/s24tile.h`: the System 24 tile chip, `sega/segaic24.cpp` (Olivier Galibert)
- `src/machine/scsp.*`, `src/machine/scspdsp.*`: the Yamaha YMF292-F SCSP and its DSP,
  `sound/scsp.cpp` and `sound/scspdsp.cpp` (ElSemi, R. Belmont; thanks to kingshriek), with the
  serial receiver and transmitter of `emu/diserial.cpp` (Carl, Miodrag Milanovic) for its MIDI link
- the sound board's map and wiring in `src/machine/model2a.*`: `sega/model2.cpp`'s `model2_snd`
  and `model2_scsp`; the stream and timer behaviour of `emu/disound.cpp` (Aaron Giles, Olivier
  Galibert) and `emu/schedule.cpp`
